newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Analysts see unchanged Danish Dec CPI.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Analysts see unchanged Danish Dec CPI.

text.p: Nine bank economists polled by Reuters on Monday said they foresaw an unchanged average 2.4 percent year-on-year rise in Danish consumer prices in December 1996, using the domestic formula of calculation.
They forecast no change from November to December. The rise from October-November was 0.2 percent.
The estimates ranged from 2.3-2.6 percent for the year-on-year data and from minus 0.1-plus 0.2 percent on a monthly basis. No forecast was made using the EU method.
The Danish National Statistics Office will issue Denmark's December CPI data on Tuesday January 21.
